notes.note: Re-read the opt-in Dockerfile command regression after real startup and held-owner readiness both succeeded but its original process-group teardown left detached lifecycle children outside that group. The fixture now signals the PID/birth-verified supervisor, waits for its launcher group, and uses real lifecycle stop identities to reap detached server/UI children before deleting the home. The final assertion verifies atomic home re-claimability, not guaranteed registry erasure after an abrupt group termination. Production self-claim, schema admission, policy preservation and capped wait behavior are unchanged.
